sources_read.section: §5.1 slices, §5.2 persistence (whitelist, stripUi, I16), §5.3 the 4-point store edit, §7 devices (breakpoints)
§3.3 layout composition order, §5.1 three tiers + components.json sample
§5.3 highlight colours: keep the hue, drop the alpha in dark mode (no palette is listed)
I5, I11, I12, I16 (persist/store checks; active once src/shared/config/redux/store.ts exists)
`shadcn info` and `shadcn add <atoms> --dry-run --view`: file placement, dependencies, import specifiers

scope: The design-system foundation only: the 10 missing shadcn atoms in src/shared/components/ui, highlight tokens in globals.css, the store seam (stripUi, persistConfig, listener middleware, typed hooks) with NO slices, LibraryProvider and its three provider folders, useBreakpoint. Out of scope: any slice (session, workspace, viewport, sync), the AuthGuard/AppHeader shell (008), any feature component, Konva colours (009/022), any Zustand or TanStack Query.

acceptance_criteria.text: input, textarea, sheet, dialog, tabs, card, skeleton, sonner, tooltip, switch exist under src/shared/components/ui (button already does); nothing lands in template/ or canvas/; every import resolves through the tsconfig aliases; cn comes from the `cn` package.
globals.css defines --highlight-{yellow,green,blue,rose} for light and dark, one hue each, alpha lower in dark, mapped for Tailwind; no hex colour under src/shared/components.
LibraryProvider composes Redux > PersistGate > Shadcn > Theme > Tooltip in that order, mounts <Toaster /> once, and layout.tsx uses it; the provider tree renders in light and dark.
useBreakpoint() returns mobile below 768, tablet 768-1279, desktop from 1280 (tests at 767/768 and 1279/1280) and is the only device branch; SSR-safe.

stripUi drops every slice's ui key; persistConfig has transforms [stripUi] and an empty whitelist; the listener middleware is prepended once; typed useAppSelector/useAppDispatch exist; verify:arch I5/I11/I12/I16 pass.

open_questions: Q6 (defaulted: breakpoint hook + sheet early, mobile layout last) — useBreakpoint ships now; the mobile layout is a later pass.
D-11 (defaulted: tablet authors, desktop analyses, mobile reads + writes notes; no ink on mobile) — the three device classes are mobile < 768, tablet 768-1279, desktop >= 1280 (03 §7).
C8 (resolved in split §3) — Redux Toolkit + redux-persist; no Zustand, no TanStack Query.

ANSWERED 2026-09-19 (owner, plan approved): the store seam is EMPTY (whitelist [], no slices; session/workspace/viewport/sync arrive with 008/009/007 through the 4-point edit) with a guard so an empty root reducer does not warn.
ANSWERED 2026-09-19: highlight tokens are yellow, green, blue, rose (defaulted palette: the spec lists none), one hue each, the same hue in both themes, lower alpha in dark.
ANSWERED 2026-09-19: install @reduxjs/toolkit, react-redux, redux-persist and sonner; shadcn add generates the atoms; PR #7 merged first (it was); slim recording.

FINDING (doc vs tool, resolved, recorded): 04 §5.1 shows components.json aliases as filesystem paths (src/shared/components/ui). The shadcn CLI PLACES files correctly from them but writes cross-atom imports with the same string: sheet.tsx and dialog.tsx would import Button from "src/shared/components/ui/button", which TypeScript cannot resolve. components.json therefore uses the import aliases (@shared/components/ui, @shared/lib/utils, ...); the 04 §5.1 sample is corrected in the same change. This also fixes a latent flaw in task 004's g2.

NEW (defaulted): ShadcnProvider is Radix's DirectionProvider (dir="ltr"), because components.json sets rtl: true and generates direction-aware classes; the app's language (Bahasa Indonesia) is left-to-right.

NEW (defaulted): the scaffold's theme-provider moves from shared/components/template/ to shared/providers/theme-provider/ (plan doc §4 places it there); layout.tsx imports LibraryProvider from shared/providers.
NEW (defaulted): the persist storage is localStorage in the browser and a no-op storage on the server, so nothing touches window at import (SSR).
risks: Persist/Redux at the layout level can break SSR or hydration; a webpack production build proves it.
Empty root reducer: Redux warns, and I16 may fail on a whitelist that names no slice; solved by an empty whitelist plus a guard reducer, checked by verify:arch.
shadcn add rewrites globals.css or components.json on some atoms: diff both after each add; the dry run showed 10 new files and 3 dependencies only.
The persist whitelist growing an entities or reducerPath entry (I12).
Konva will not inherit the tokens; tasks 009/022 pass colours explicitly.
